extracted.name: Cold Shrimp Salad
extracted.description: This cold shrimp salad without mayo is perfect for summer and includes fresh avocado, bell peppers, and garlic.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds cooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined without tail
instruction_lines: Place shrimp in a large mixing bowl with red and green bell peppers, garlic, onion, cilantro, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to develop. Serve chilled.
